mentions.name: MeshLive
mentions.description: Open-source app for voice/video calls and livestreaming over Bluetooth mesh without internet, where nearby phones relay to extend the range. Available on Android (recently released on the Play Store), iOS, macOS, and Windows; still experimental, with live video working over BLE.
mentions.problem: Enables voice/video calls and livestreaming without internet connectivity.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on MeshLive, an open-source app for voice/video calls and livestreaming over Bluetooth mesh without internet. Nearby phone relay to extend the range.
